subject: corpus: QuartzCore compositor gate started (host-only, workers=1, no build)
body: Root-assigned QuartzCore compositor gate on compiler 742cdf3d8d10 + host cdylib 06a6c6ee4e45. Output dir gpu/build/ui-corpus-20261025/compositor-gate-20261025 (private). Method: own harness (does not touch corpus_inputs tool or its evidence), isolated child per pair, prlimit AS 2GiB/CPU 12s, workers=1, compile via tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_options with DRAW_PARAMETERS|EXTENDED_VARYINGS exactly as render_pipeline.inc tegu_render_compile_generic_options does (SELECT_RT rt0 for the dual-attachment MRT shape the captured QC descriptors use), plus translator create_with_attachment_blends/vertex_descriptor and the vertex-fetch coverage check from tegu_render_generic_prepare. Formats probed 80,115,70,10 (the only n2r_bpp-admitted set). corpus_inputs: will ingest your L3b results-enriched.jsonl for fixed_*/function-constant rows rather than re-extracting; no re-extraction of the 15568 AIR modules. Note for render: under NORD2_JM_TRANSPORT a failed generic compile -> nord2_render_error -> nil PSO -> QuartzCore aborts; the gate counts exactly those.
